The flames are bright and shifting, creating a sense of movement. The camera remains static, with no panning or tilting. The background remains consistently dark, which accentuates the brightness and vividness of the fire. There are no visible objects or characters in the frame, focusing entirely on the flames.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene dominated by intense flames against a dark background. The fire is dynamic, with bright orange and yellow hues dominating the frame. The flames are vigorous, flickering and dancing, creating a sense of movement and energy. As the video progresses, the flames grow larger and more intense, with sparks flying off into the darkness, adding to the chaotic beauty of the scene. The background remains consistently dark, which accentuates the brightness and vividness of the fire. There are no visible objects or characters in the frame, focusing entirely on the raw power and beauty of the flames. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully absorb the intensity and scale of the fire.
caption: The video captures a fire burning against a black night sky, with a bright yellow-white flame mass anchored in the lower-left throughout. Above this base, a taller, dimmer orange plume rises and continuously deforms, cycling between a rightward-curving hook and a vertical column with a curling top. The plume's upper part repeatedly breaks into detached wisps that drift upward and fade while the bright base stays connected below. The bottom core expands and contracts, shifting its outline from broad rounded bulges to narrower columns. Small glowing embers scatter across the dark background. The plume's tip swings from upper-right to upper-center and back toward a rightward hook. The hook forms, loosens into diffuse orange smoke, and re-forms without the base flame leaving its position.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.

or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
